standard_changes.title: Standard Software Installation
standard_changes.description: Install clients or tools from the approved software allowlist
standard_changes.implementation_plan: Verify version and licensing, follow the standard installation procedure, and confirm availability.
standard_changes.rollback_plan: Uninstall the software and restore the original configuration.
prerequisites: Software is on the approved allowlist
standard_changes.remarks: May be performed by the service desk.

standard_changes.title: Low Risk Firewall Rule Change
standard_changes.description: Add or modify access control rules within the approved scope
standard_changes.implementation_plan: Verify source, destination, ports, expiry, and business owner; test connectivity after the change.
standard_changes.rollback_plan: Remove new rules or restore the original rule snapshot.
standard_changes.remarks: High risk access changes require the normal change process.

standard_changes.title: Database Account Access Change
standard_changes.description: Adjust database account access using least privilege
standard_changes.implementation_plan: Verify the account, database and table scope, and access level; apply permissions and record an audit trail.
standard_changes.rollback_plan: Revoke added permissions or restore the original access snapshot.
standard_changes.justification: Support business operations and data access requirements.
standard_changes.remarks: Production write access requires security review.

known_errors.title: Known Error Template: Replace with the actual problem title
